info.name: ToolJet External Applications API
info.description:
The ToolJet External API provides REST endpoints for managing users, workspaces, applications (export/import), groups, and user role assignments across a ToolJet instance. It is enabled via environment variables and secured with a static access token using Basic authentication.

Contact Support:
